methodology.name: Interpretable Context Methodology (ICM)
methodology.description: Deterministic 5-stage sequential lifecycle enforcing interpretable context transitions via stage contracts.

stage_contracts.stage: Scope boundaries, constraints, out-of-scope declarations, and turn token budget table (<= 8,000 tokens).
Technical architecture, impacted symbol manifest, and OKR Acceptance Matrix with machine-verifiable exit criteria.
Search/replace change tracking, symbol modification ledger, and escape-hatch justifications.
Automated test execution logs, linter outputs, browser verification notes, and token telemetry ledger.
Retrospective observations, learnings, and bidirectional updates to docs/ and docs/log.md.

specification.name: Google Cloud Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.2)
specification.bundle_root: Strictly lowercase. Frontmatter contains ONLY okf_version: "0.2". Catalog of bundle-relative links.
specification.knowledge_log: Strictly lowercase. Chronological update log fed exclusively from task retrospectives.
specification.spec_versions: Pinned upstream SHAs, dates, and declared versions.
specification.house_rule: Strict schema validation rejecting undeclared frontmatter keys to prevent metadata sprawl and cache bust.
specification.visualizer: Cytoscape.js interactive network graph mapping concept relations.

governance_invariants.invariant: Sections 1-4 of prompt context must never contain timestamps, dynamic build counters, or volatile metadata to protect prompt prefix caching.
Files exceeding 50 lines must use SEARCH/REPLACE blocks. Full file overwrites require logged justification in 03_exec.md.
Direct complete-file dumps barred when AST symbol queries suffice. Use ast-grep or scripts/repo_map.py.
All shell commands must run via scripts/filter_output.py. Raw terminal outputs in conversational context are prohibited.
Git modification tools barred during 01_intake and 02_plan. Sequential-thinking tools barred during 03_exec and 04_verify.
Transitioning from 02_plan to 03_exec strictly requires an approved OKR matrix with automated verification commands.

utility.name: repo_map.py
utility.role: AST symbol tree extraction and signature compression
utility.tokenizer_margin_rule: Target 1,800 tokens via tiktoken cl100k_base to account for OpenAI BPE vs Gemini tokenizer divergence, guaranteeing <= 2,000 tokens.
utility.algorithm: Binary search pruning incorporating telemetry header into budget evaluation across all scale targets.

utility.name: filter_output.py
utility.role: CLI command execution wrapper and conversational log sanitizer
utility.behavior_success: Collapses output on exit code 0 to: ✓ Command succeeded: [args]
utility.behavior_failure: Strips noise and emits only failing assertions, files, line numbers, and immediate stack traces.
utility.windows_batch_resolution: Utilizes shutil.which to seamlessly execute Windows .cmd/.bat binaries (npx, npm, ast-grep).
